turns.speaker: A
turns.text: Good morning! Welcome to the library. How can I help you today? You look like you've just walked through a car wash.

turns.speaker: B
turns.text: Morning! Um, yes, I'd like to join, please. I've never had a card here before, and everyone keeps telling me I need one. My flatmates say the reading room here is the quietest place in town.

turns.speaker: A
turns.text: Well, you've come to the right place. Busy week for you, I expect? It's the first week of term, and we've had people queuing out of the door since Monday.

turns.speaker: B
turns.text: Oh, I can imagine. Everyone on campus is running around with maps and timetables. I got lost twice yesterday, and it's pouring with rain again today, as usual.

turns.speaker: A
turns.text: Typical British weather, I'm afraid! Anyway, let's get you sorted. I'll fill in the application as we chat. Could I start with your first name, please?

turns.speaker: B
turns.text: Of course. It's Bronwyn, spelled B-R-O-N-W-Y-N. It's a Welsh name, so people often get it wrong.

turns.speaker: A
turns.text: Thank you, Bronwyn, that's a lovely name. Now, where are you living at the moment? Is it in one of the halls?

turns.speaker: B
turns.text: Not quite, no. I'm renting a flat near the campus with two other girls from my course. It's number 47. It's just above a bakery, so the whole place smells of fresh bread every morning, which is lovely.

turns.speaker: A
turns.text: Oh, that sounds nice, I'm quite jealous. I can never resist a warm loaf on the way home from work. And what's the name of the road, please?

turns.speaker: B
turns.text: Um, it's Whitcombe Road, W-H-I-T-C-O-M-B-E. People always forget the little E at the end, even the postman, I think.

turns.speaker: A
turns.text: Right, got that. It's easy to miss, and the system is fussy about it. And which town is that in? There are a few villages round here, so I'd better check.

turns.speaker: B
turns.text: Ah, yes. It's Cannock, C-A-N-N-O-C-K. Most people say it a bit differently, to be honest, but that's how it's written.

turns.speaker: A
turns.text: Perfect. And have you got a contact number? A mobile is fine.

turns.speaker: B
turns.text: Um, let me think, I only got the new SIM last week. I think it's 07700 900 417.

turns.speaker: A
turns.text: Sorry, was that 07700 900 470?

turns.speaker: B
turns.text: No, sorry, it's 07700 900 417, with a seven right at the end. I always mumble that one.

turns.speaker: A
turns.text: Thanks, that's fixed now. I always read numbers back twice, it saves so much trouble later. So, what do you do all day, apart from getting lost on campus and queuing for coffee?

turns.speaker: B
turns.text: Ha! Well, I'm a student, just started my first year of Geography. I still can't quite believe it, really. It feels like I only finished school last week, and now there are reading lists as long as my arm.

turns.speaker: A
turns.text: Brilliant, good for you. Then I'll need the number from your university card, if you have it with you.

turns.speaker: B
turns.text: Yes, I do, hold on. Um, here we are. It's 21509.

turns.speaker: A
turns.text: Was that 21590?

turns.speaker: B
turns.text: No, it's 21509, so two-one-five-oh-nine. Those cards have tiny writing, don't they? I nearly needed a magnifying glass when I picked mine up at the welcome desk.

turns.speaker: A
turns.text: They really do. Right, that's nearly everything. Your new card will be ready in a few days, so which day would suit you for collecting it? We're open six days a week.

turns.speaker: B
turns.text: Let me see. Tuesday would be... no, sorry, I've got a seminar on Tuesday. Thursday is better, I finish early that day.

turns.speaker: A
turns.text: That's fine, it'll be waiting for you at the main desk with your name on it. Which of our libraries would be easiest for you to pick it up from?

turns.speaker: B
turns.text: I'd like Eastgate, please, because it's the nearest one to my flat and I can walk there. I'd rather not take the bus if I can help it.

turns.speaker: A
turns.text: Lovely, I'll note that down. Last thing, we like to know how people came across us. Did someone mention us to you, or did you just wander past one day?

turns.speaker: B
turns.text: Oh, no, nothing like that. I saw it on the university website, in the welcome pages for new starters.

turns.speaker: A
turns.text: Wonderful, that's good to know. That's all done, Bronwyn. Welcome to the library, and good luck with your first term!

turns.speaker: B
turns.text: Thank you so much, you've been really helpful. Have a lovely day!

evidence.quote: No, sorry, it's 07700 900 417, with a seven right at the end.
Well, I'm a student, just started my first year of Geography.
Thursday is better, I finish early that day.
I'd like Eastgate, please, because it's the nearest one to my flat and I can walk there. I'd rather not take the bus if I can help it.
I saw it on the university website, in the welcome pages for new starters.
